component.name: Fan Control
component.summary: Manage cooling on HP Victus and OMEN laptops

description.p: Take control of cooling on supported HP Victus and OMEN laptops. Choose the right thermal profile for your work and check both fans at a glance.

ul.li: Choose Quiet, Cool, Balanced, or Performance when supported by your firmware
Run both fans at maximum speed, then switch back to automatic cooling
See live CPU and GPU fan speeds, updated every second
Follow your desktop's light or dark appearance

description.p: Authenticate once per app session to change settings. Use Lock Fan Controls in the menu to require authentication again. Max fan speed stays active when you close the app; turn it off to restore automatic cooling.
This app supports HP firmware controls and does not provide custom fan curves or arbitrary RPM targets. Availability depends on your laptop and Linux driver.

Host-command access is required. The host must provide polkit and a graphical authentication agent. A compiled helper is included, so no host Python or Go installation is required. No companion service package is needed. Preview mode works without supported hardware.

screenshot.caption: Thermal profiles and live fan speeds in light appearance
Thermal profiles and live fan speeds in dark appearance

description.p: Synchronize thermal profile changes with GNOME power modes and TuneD via D-Bus, while retaining firmware-specific cool mode.
Bundle a static compiled helper for hardware discovery, verification, and session fan controls. Remove host Python and coreutils dependencies while retaining one authentication per app session.
Authenticate once per app session for thermal profile and fan changes. Lock controls from the menu or close the app to end the privileged session.
Replace preview screenshots with live hardware captures in light and dark appearance.
Add hosted screenshots, project and support links, and a signed update repository for a complete software-center listing.
Include the application icon and full software information in the Flatpak installer.
Initial release with thermal profiles, maximum fan mode, and live fan readings.
